name: Residence Permit on Assured Income

requirements.blocker_text: Initial deposit of FJD 100,000 in a local bank account (waivable if the applicant instead purchases Fiji property of demonstrated equivalent value).
requirements.fix_path: Deposit or invest the required amount.

requirements.blocker_text: Ongoing annual deposit of FJD 30,000 for a family of 2, or FJD 40,000 for a family of up to 5.
Cannot seek employment in Fiji; English-language competency, police clearance, medical report, and health insurance also required.

outcome.duration_length: not confirmed in this build -- open gap on the specific permit validity period

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Fiji (Embassy Washington DC mission page) -- Residency (Residence Permit on Assured Income): minimum age 45, health insurance, no local employment, English competency, police clearance, medical report, FJD 100,000 initial deposit (waivable via equivalent property purchase), FJD 30,000/40,000 ongoing annual deposit, FJD 477.00 fee

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Fiji). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- sourced to a Fiji Ministry of Foreign Affairs diplomatic-mission page, treated as tier-1 (a mission-level restatement of the residency rules, not the Immigration Act itself, but still an official government source). This is Fiji's primary non-investor PR route -- effectively a retiree/passive-income category; there is NO points-based or skills-scoring PR route in Fiji, confirmed absent rather than a research gap. GAP: exact permit duration not disclosed by the source. The investor-linked PR pathway (see fj_investor_residence.json) is implied by the naturalisation structure's PR-permit precondition but immigration.gov.fj's own investor pages do not explicitly state an investor-to-PR conversion timeline -- disclosed as a separate, unresolved gap, not conflated with this file. citizenship_after_months (96) reflects the transitional 8-of-10-year naturalisation rule from fj_citizenship_naturalisation.json.
